name: test_verify_order_search_functionality[chromium]
description:
Test Case 2: Verify Order Search Functionality

Steps:
    1. Navigate to Amazon homepage
    2. Login with valid credentials
    3. Navigate to Your Orders page
    4. Verify search box is visible
    5. Enter a search term (e.g., "iphone") in the order search box
    6. Click search button
    7. Verify either orders are displayed OR "no orders found" message appears

Expected Result:
    - Search box should be visible and functional
    - Search results should load (either orders or no results message)
    - Page should not crash or show errors
